title: Amber Execution Contract (v1)
description: F068 (Harness v2 §13/§24/§31): the DECLARED boundary of one governed execution as an admitted, immutable artifact. Declared vs Effective vs Observed must be comparable; observed outside declared BLOCKs, never silently continues. Adapters prepare and report — Amber does not own the sandbox (§24): isolation stays with the existing worktree seam and the governed gates. Absence of an optional section means 'governed by the existing gates', never unbounded.

base.description: The declared base (e.g. HEAD or a branch). The adapter reports the effective base it actually prepared.

mode.description: Default posture is deny (Harness v2 §4.1/§22). H2a declares it; enforcement stays with the existing gates.

items.description: A repo-relative path prefix (posix-style). Absolute paths, '.'/'..' segments, and backslashes refuse in core.
